node.title: Upstream headline conjecture: entropy-subfield envelope
node.statement: UPSTREAM HEADLINE CONJECTURE (upstream: przchojecki/rs-mca towards-prize.md (2026-07-01 revision) + cap25 v13 raw notes): the closed-form threshold delta*_C(eps*) = 1 - rho - g*(rho,beta) + o(1) (the entropy-subfield envelope). This is the upstream program-level answer-shape our conjectural_mca_delta.py row map should converge to; kept as a named CONJECTURE for visibility in the shared artifact. Consistent with our corridor arithmetic (batch-1 crossings) at the four rates.
